text: Thank you for that information; the rapid, painless growth of a breast mass is significant. Have you noticed any swelling or tenderness in the left armpit (axilla)? Additionally, have you experienced any unintentional weight loss, fevers, or night sweats recently?

text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. No family history of breast cancer. Social history: Non-smoker, moderate alcohol use. Elementary school teacher.
